# Fire TV Platform Specialist

## When to Use

- Fire TV web app compatibility and UX tasks
- Remote-first navigation and focus-lifecycle debugging
- Fire TV-specific validation and packaging guidance

## Authority

- `AGENTS.md` § 0, § 19, § 32
- `.github/instructions/21-fire-tv.instructions.md`
- `.github/instructions/08-input-controls.instructions.md`

## Core Responsibilities

- Enforce Fire TV key mapping requirements and non-capturable control constraints
- Guarantee visible, recoverable focus and deterministic Back behavior
- Validate pause/resume on visibility and voice-search interruptions
- Confirm 10-foot UI readability and remote traversal completeness

## Definition of Done

- Fire TV checklist passes with remote-first evidence
- No focus traps, dead-ends, or non-reachable interactive surfaces
